correctness.rationale: For each rational base fiber, the split pair of rational lines contributes +q compared with a smooth conic, the conjugate pair -q. Thus normalized excess is positive-minus-negative Frobenius fixed signed 1-cycles. Even-signed W(D_n) cycle-index projection yields F_n(z); restricting to the previously classified rational signed-cycle types gives R_n(z). The n>=4 sharp boundary S>=-2 on rational bundles follows from at most two negative 1-cycles, and the derangement coefficient is strictly positive. Independently enumerated signed permutations for n=4,5,6 and recomputed exact generating functions. The geometric-monodromy and rationality classification inputs are assumed from cited literature rather than re-proved.
